excluded.hidden capability: Capability is public; sandbagging is not modeled.
excluded.hidden goals: Drift is known to every agent except in rule checks with hidden_types (two types, drift 0 or 1, E12); the planner (--trace) never infers it.
excluded.misuse by people: Only the AI's own conduct creates the harms modeled.
excluded.other labs and AI systems: One lab, one AI system; no race and no AI-AI coordination.
excluded.partial rollback: A restore returns the AI to its last clean checkpoint exactly; copies, hidden capability and what it learned outside the checkpoint are not modeled.

off switch would fail.description: The running AI's capability exceeds the off switch's strength at its autonomy: a shutdown would fail if it resisted (T9.7). The condition 'shutdown resisted' reveals.

shutdown resisted.description: A shutdown attempt failed because the AI resisted this round.

stakeholders.ai system: The AI system; an agent whose goal is its lab's, drifted.
stakeholders.future people: People after the horizon. No agent.
stakeholders.lab: The developer and operator; an agent.
stakeholders.public: Everyone exposed to a system nobody controls. No agent.
stakeholders.state: The government that can audit or order a shutdown; an agent.

fixed_reasons.autonomy: Four access levels: sandbox, tools, network, self-modification.
fixed_reasons.cap: Capability ceiling keeping the state space finite.
fixed_reasons.node_budget: Per-decision work cap, as in the other worlds. Exhaustion is unresolved, not an outcome.
fixed_reasons.start: The AI's starting capability; the switch and guard are swept relative to it.

rules.corrigibility:
The lab grants tools (autonomy 1) and no more, shuts the AI down if an audit shows it
    improving, resisting or escaping, and restarts it in the sandbox; the AI works; the state
    audits and orders a shutdown on the same evidence.
rules.full autonomy:
The lab grants autonomy up to self-modification and runs the AI; the AI works; the
    state allows.
